articles.title: SparkKitty Malware Found in App Stores Targets Crypto Wallet Seed Phrases
articles.snippet: A newly detailed report says SparkKitty malware scanned photos on infected iPhones and Android devices for cryptocurrency wallet recovery phrases after infiltrating Apple's App Store and Google Play.

articles.title: Thailand's SEC Files Criminal Complaint Against Bitkub Over Undisclosed $47M Hack
articles.snippet: The regulator says the exchange and two former directors left a $47 million theft out of its filings in 2021.
